name: What is the process for building a multigenerational home addition?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for building a multigenerational home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically starts with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, budget, and needs. This leads to preliminary design and architectural drawings, which are refined based on your feedback. Once designs are approved, we handle the permitting process with the local jurisdiction. After permits are secured, construction begins, involving site preparation, foundation work, framing, roofing, utility installations (plumbing, electrical, HVAC), and interior finishes. Throughout construction, there are regular inspections, and upon completion, a final walkthrough and occupancy approval.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, permitting, construction (foundation, framing, utilities, finishes), inspections, and final walkthrough.
